name: email-resend
title: Email with Resend: your app sends sign-in links and invitations (needs an API key)
description: `email.send` with Resend's API: one email to one person, from the sender in EMAIL_FROM. Variables only (RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM), so both targets.

environment.name: RESEND_API_KEY
environment.description: A Resend API key with sending access, from resend.com/api-keys. Read through secrets at start; sent only to Resend.

environment.name: EMAIL_FROM
environment.description: The sender of every email: `bot@example.com` or `Assistant <bot@example.com>`, on a domain verified in Resend (resend.com/domains).
